_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). Los Angeles Trade-Technical 45285 (Cal-GETC certificate) was read from PDF p.65 alone, the pattern's Areas 4 to 6; its note says the heading and Areas 1 to 3 are on earlier pages, so 53 of its 99 listed courses are placed and it is not collectable. This read prints pp.61-67 whole, so a session can name the section's first page, the words it opens on and its last page for a pdf_pages pin. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.calgetc_section: The page and words the Cal-GETC pattern (or its Certificate of Achievement) opens on, each Area's page, and where the section ends.
